item.title: Pedestrian killed in New Castle crash; driver cited for DUI, state police say
item.description: Delaware State Police are investigating a fatal pedestrian crash in New Castle that left a 64-year-old man dead. A driver was cited for DUI.

item.title: Flight cancellations announced at Philadelphia International Airport ahead of winter storm
item.description: Most airlines have canceled Sunday, Jan. 25 flights at Philadelphia International Airport as a precaution due to the winter storm. Passengers should check with their airline before arriving.
